name: astro-perf
headline: Web Developer — Astro, Headless CMS, Core Web Vitals
summary: Web developer who builds fast content and marketing sites on Astro, Next.js and headless CMSs (Strapi), and fixes slow ones. Last rescue: mobile PageSpeed 69 to 99 and load time from 16 seconds to under 2, verified in the client's 5.0 review. Built consolline.com solo: four languages, WebGL2 animation, checked against Figma with pixel diffs. Multi-locale routing, SEO, deployments on Vercel and Cloudflare, everything handed over under the client's own accounts.
